caption: The drawing depicts a transparent, bluish-green glass cup with two handles, resting on a matching saucer. The cup has a wide mouth, slightly flared lip, and a rounded body that narrows towards the base, which then expands into a small circular foot. There are two rectangular insets: the upper left inset is a top-down view of the cup and saucer, clearly showing concentric rings and the circular base; the upper right inset provides a side view of the cup, showing its contours and both handles from a different perspective. The objects are rendered using shades of blue and green, with the transparency and reflective qualities of glass illustrated through varying tints and highlights. The artist’s signature, “JANET RIZA,” appears at the bottom right corner of the drawing. The objects are centered in a rectangular plain background with softly defined borders.
title: Flower Pot and Base
